faq_add.q: How many colleges can I join for a Purbanchal University BBA, and which district has the most?
faq_add.a: The PU Faculty of Management table lists 45 colleges with an approved BBA quota, 4,017 seats in total where a number is given (Purbanchal University faculty pages (purbanchaluniversity.edu.np, checked 19 Nov 2026)). Kathmandu has 14 of them, then Morang with 4 and Sunsari, Saptari and Dhanusha with 3 each. The biggest quotas are 192 at Southwestern School of Management and Technology, and 144 each at ten colleges, among them Zenith International College (Biratnagar), Presidency College of Management Sciences (Bharatpur), Janaki College of Management (Janakpur) and Birgunj Public College. A quota is the university approval, not a promise of a seat.

faq_add.q: Which Purbanchal University colleges run BBS, and how large is the biggest one?
faq_add.a: The PU Faculty of Management lists 18 colleges with a BBS quota, 1,740 seats in total where a number is given (Purbanchal University faculty pages (purbanchaluniversity.edu.np, checked 19 Nov 2026)). The largest quota is 300 at Annapurna Multiple Campus, Kanchanrup (Saptari), then 240 at Royal Softech College, Lahan (Siraha) and 180 at Public Campus, Dhanibanigaun (Morang). Compare this with the TU BBS list under the same route before you decide.

faq_add.q: Where can I study BCA or BIT under Purbanchal University?
faq_add.a: The PU Faculty of Science and Technology lists 9 colleges with a BCA quota (556 seats, the biggest are Gomendra Multiple College, Birtamode with 96 and Kantipur City College with 80) and 29 with a BIT quota (1,444 seats where a number is given, 96 each at Himalayan WhiteHouse International College and Aryan School of Engineering and Management) (Purbanchal University faculty pages (purbanchaluniversity.edu.np, checked 19 Nov 2026)). Several community campuses outside Kathmandu also run BIT, among them Lamahi (Dang), Nepalgunj (Banke), Janakpur and Hetauda.

faq_add.q: Which Purbanchal University colleges offer B.Ed. outside Kathmandu?
faq_add.a: The PU Faculty of Education table has 37 rows and lists 33 colleges with a B.Ed. quota, 2,910 seats in total where a number is given (Purbanchal University faculty pages (purbanchaluniversity.edu.np, checked 19 Nov 2026)). The biggest are Public Campus, Dhanibanigaun (Morang), Laxmiballav Narsing Multiple College, Babhangamakatti (Saptari) and Annapurna Multiple Campus, Kanchanrup (Saptari) with 200 each. Remote campuses are also listed, for example Everest Multiple College in Salleri (Solukhumbu), Gurans Multiple Campus (Dailekh) and Narayani Multiple Campus (Taplejung). A one year B.Ed. quota is listed separately for some colleges.

faq_add.q: Which law colleges does Purbanchal University approve for BA LL.B?
faq_add.a: The PU Faculty of Law table lists 19 law colleges, 18 of them with a B.A. LL.B. quota, 1,430 seats in total where a number is given (Purbanchal University faculty pages (purbanchaluniversity.edu.np, checked 19 Nov 2026)). The largest are Kathmandu School of Law (250) and Bright Vision Law College, Biratnagar (180). Colleges outside Kathmandu include Siddhartha Law Campus (Hetauda), Shree College of Law (Bharatpur) and Solukhumbu Law Campus (Salleri). The 5 year B.A. LL.B. and the 3 year LL.B. are different entries, so check which one a college runs.

faq_add.q: How does Pathways read the seat numbers for Purbanchal University colleges?
faq_add.a: Each college row on the PU faculty pages ends with "Approved Programs/Quotas", for example BBA-96 or MBA (Spring/Fall)-33/33. Pathways keeps the number as the yearly approved quota for that course (Purbanchal University faculty pages (purbanchaluniversity.edu.np, checked 19 Nov 2026)); when a course has two intakes, the two numbers are added (MBA 33/33 shows 66) and the original text stays in the college note. The quota is not the number of students admitted and it says nothing about fees, so ask the college for the current notice.

faq_add.q: Why does a Pathways college say "Not stated" for its sector?
faq_add.a: The PU faculty tables give a name, a town, a district and the approved programmes, but not whether the college is private, community or public. Pathways labels a college Community only when it is also on the NPCA member list (npca.edu.np), Public when it is a constituent unit of the university itself, and Private only when the name says so (Pvt. Ltd., International, College of Management and similar). Everything else says Not stated rather than guessing (Purbanchal University faculty pages (purbanchaluniversity.edu.np, checked 19 Nov 2026)).

faq_add.q: What can I study at Rajarshi Janak University in Janakpur?

MLT, BJMC, LL.B., B.A. LL.B., B.Sc. Agriculture, MBA, LL.M. and two M.Phil. courses (Management, Eastern Philosophy). Gaushala Engineering Campus, the second constituent campus, runs the Bachelor in Civil Engineering; Mahagadhi Mai Campus also lists BIT and Pandit Mangal Kumar Upadhyay Multiple Campus lists B.Sc. Agriculture. Seats and fees are not on the course search, so read the admission notice.
